title: Raster Semio Example Not Showing
description: The raster app's semio example (semio.raster.json) isn't showing anything on screen. Investigate root cause in the raster plugin / paint surface / document load path and fix so the Semio Brand Showcase renders correctly.
summary: Fixed the Semio raster example blank canvas. Root cause: plugin Adjustment layers dropped `params` on deserialize, then paint host required `params` so `syncDocumentJson` threw and never composited the fixture. Preserved adjustment params in the plugin domain, defaulted paint-host params, fixed group/parent transform propagation (compositor + picking), and taught wgpu paint2d to use cameraJson, center quads, and draw layers without imageKey. Verified with framework_surface_paint (9) and raster-plugin (25) tests plus wgpu cargo check.
